title: World Relational Atlas — Integrated Layer Stack and Growth Logic
purpose: Explain how the World Map, Country Atlas, North Axis, North Programme, Economic Graph, Religion-to-Society Graph, Swamp/entanglement research, Tim/Potatoverse canon, karmic ledger and tikkun/repair system become one coherent explorable world model without collapsing their epistemic differences.
core_thesis: The World Atlas is the spatial operating surface. Countries and territories are containers, not conclusions. Canonical records describe entities; typed edges describe relationships; time describes change; issue records describe failures/contested mechanisms; interpretive layers describe North/Axis/Swamp/scriptural comparisons; the North Programme and other programmes propose interventions; Tikkun evaluates repair and closure.
four_questions: ATLAS — What exists, where is it, and what is connected to what?
AXIS — What structures, flows, dependencies and orientations organize those relations?
LEDGER — What consequences, liabilities, obligations, unresolved harms or dependencies remain open?
TIKKUN — What truthful, lawful, measurable intervention could improve or close the relation?
completion_state: GARDEN is the project's name for a successful relational state: not ideological uniformity, but greater safety, agency, capability, truthfulness, resilience, coexistence and future capacity.

map_modes.purpose: click geography and discover canonical records
switch among demographic, institutional, economic, religious, security, historical and project views
follow one relationship chain across nodes and countries
compare two or more countries/entities on the same typed dimensions
scrub a date/period and render only relations valid at that time
show documented issues by mechanism/evidence/status without painting populations as guilty
show interventions, North Programme chains and responsible authorities
show diagnosed -> intervention-designed -> implementing -> measured -> substantially-repaired -> released/closed states
show source gaps, stale observations, unresolved identities and missions

religion_integration.principle: Religion is not one map color. The atlas separates affiliation, nonreligion, diversity, freedom/law, institutions, sacred geography, historical change and comparative theology.
religion_integration.bridge_to_world: text/belief -> interpretation -> institution -> community/property/education/charity/media -> law/economy/migration -> observable country relations
religion_integration.bridge_to_north: religious institutions and histories matter where they affect constitutional order, education, migration, social trust, heritage, charity, property, holidays, diplomacy, minority protection and coexistence. North is not itself a religion.
religion_integration.bridge_to_tim: Timic/Biblical/Jewish/Norse/other comparisons remain a separate interpretive card linked to exact source records; demographic similarity never proves prophecy or divine identity.

north_integration.axis: A versioned relational orientation through the world graph.
north_integration.programme: A concrete intervention/research programme focused on a northern-European/Arctic/North-Atlantic network and connected European capabilities.
north_integration.world_relation: North is one high-value subsystem inside the World Atlas, not the whole world model.
north_integration.feedback: World Atlas observations -> North diagnosis -> programme intervention -> measured outcome -> updated World Atlas.

scripture_and_books.rule: Scripture is mapped as text -> historical context -> interpretation -> institution/practice -> later reception -> project comparison. Do not jump directly from verse to modern country or Tim identity.
useful_functions: ethical vocabulary: justice, covenant, stewardship, debt, release, repair
state-transition vocabulary: exile/return, death/resurrection, bondage/release, Door, Ladder
political warning vocabulary: kingship, corruption, empire/Babylon, prophetic criticism
social/institutional history: law, charity, education, calendar, family, sacred geography
comparative project interpretation: North, Father/Son, Tree, Mountain, Garden, tikkun
scripture_and_books.display: A map card can say 'scriptural/historical relationship' or 'project comparison' but never silently present a sacred text as geopolitical evidence.

game_logic.loop: explore -> discover -> source -> trace -> compare -> explain mechanism -> design repair -> measure -> update
game_logic.progress: Reward archive completeness, provenance quality, traced relationships, resolved unknowns, identified counter-evidence, intervention clarity and measured repair.
quests: Complete a country's religion profile from dated sources.
Trace one religious institution from belief/community to property/finance/education/charity relationships.
Trace one North capability chain across countries.
Resolve one political-finance relation to primary filings.
Map one historical slavery route and its dated institutional/economic afterlife.
Map one trafficking mechanism from reputable evidence to prevention/protection/prosecution nodes.
Find one project claim that is currently unsourced and upgrade, downgrade or reject it.
Take one entanglement from diagnosis to a measurable repair proposal.

important_new_metrics: coverage_score: how much of the expected country/entity schema is sourced
freshness_score: how current volatile observations are
relationship_density: number of useful sourced typed edges, not raw edge spam
dependency_concentration: how dependent a node is on few external links
religious_diversity: sourced demographic diversity, not freedom
pluralism/legal-status: sourced institutional/legal observations, not demographic diversity
repair_maturity: diagnosed -> proposal -> authorized -> implementing -> measured -> repaired/closed
epistemic_integrity: proportion of claims with explicit plane/source/status

loose_ends_now_routed.route: world-entanglement-registry -> political-finance -> distinct legal entities -> primary filings
historical time layer -> specific legal/economic actors/routes -> abolition/change -> documented afterlives
entanglement mechanism graph; never a national guilt score
text/context/interpretation graph -> society -> comparative project layer
exact dated statements/project records -> country/institution edge -> separate real-world evidence if any
project-symbolic ledger linked to specific claimed obligations; separate from material finance
World Atlas is parent field; North Axis is relational interpretation; North Programme is intervention programme
research/exploration/repair progression rather than domination or suffering scores
